name: ASM Auto Supply
old_description: Discount Auto Parts 60638 Chicago Warehouse of Car Parts in Stock
about:
ASM Auto Supply operates from Chicago's Clearing neighborhood, near Midway Airport. The company runs a storefront and warehouse serving the surrounding communities. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed.

The business stocks new and vintage OEM automotive parts, truck parts, industrial hoses, belts, cleaning supplies, and fluids. Its warehouse holds thousands of vintage components purchased from dealerships, alongside hundreds of unlisted items. Services include free local delivery to businesses, garages, and homes; nationwide shipping for hard-to-find parts; free rotor and drum grinding (for a limited period); and part identification assistance with special ordering for non-stock items.

Customers include local repair shops, fleet operators, industrial maintenance teams, and vintage vehicle restorers across Chicago zip codes such as Bedford Park, Bridgeview, Burbank, Cicero, Oak Lawn, and others. The company also ships nationwide to individuals and shops seeking obsolete OEM parts.

ASM Auto Supply positions itself as a lower-priced alternative to national chains like AutoZone and Advance Auto Parts, emphasizing neighborhood service, free delivery, and a deep inventory of out-of-production parts sourced directly from dealerships.

name: AVA Rocky Mountains
old_description: Bringing Cutting-Edge Technology Home with User-Friendly Systems.
about:
AVA Rocky Mountains operates from Silverthorne, Colorado, serving the High Rockies region and the broader state. The company was established by a team whose combined experience in audio-visual and automation technology spans more than three decades, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been published.

The firm designs and installs integrated low-voltage systems for homes and commercial properties. Its service portfolio covers audio and video distribution, home theater and media room construction, LED lighting design, structured networking, telephone systems, entry systems, and whole-home automation. A cloud-based remote monitoring platform — built on ihiji's OVRC gateway — allows the team to watch control processors, touch panels, routers, projectors, and networked displays around the clock, performing remote reboots and diagnostics before an on-site visit is needed.

Customers fall into two main groups: residential owners looking to upgrade their living spaces, and commercial and hospitality clients requiring large-scale AV and control solutions. Projects range from single-room media installations to property-wide automation across the Colorado High Rockies.

The company positions itself on simplicity and speed, promising expedited project delivery and a free in-home consultation to start each engagement. Its differentiator is the proactive monitoring layer, which aims to detect, diagnose, and resolve issues — often without rolling a truck — reducing downtime for end users.

name: AVID Racing (UTV)
old_description: Precision-machined titanium hardware, designed in-house for maximum strength-to-weight, precise fitment, and ultimate corrosion resistance.
about:
AVID Racing operates from Fresno, California, where it designs, engineers, and manufactures its UTV suspension systems and titanium hardware under one roof. The company emphasizes that all engineering, manufacturing, and support functions are housed in its Fresno facility, though a founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces platform-specific suspension kits, titanium hardware replacement packages, shocks, and builder components for side-by-side vehicles. Its product line includes complete front and rear long-travel kits, control arms, trailing arms, and hundreds of titanium bolt kits tailored to models such as the Can-Am Maverick R, Polaris RZR Pro R, and Yamaha YXZ1000. Materials used are 7075 aluminum, 4130 chromoly, and Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy, selected per application. Manufacturing processes include precision machining, welding, and assembly, with fitment verified through an online Shock Center that matches specifications to vehicle configurations.

AVID serves the off-road powersports market, targeting UTV owners, racers, and fabricators who need direct-fit suspension upgrades and corrosion-resistant hardware. Concrete applications span Can-Am Maverick R and X3, Polaris RZR Pro R, and Yamaha YXZ1000 platforms, with kits ranging from 12-piece shock bolt sets to 170-piece ultimate suspension replacement packages.

The company differentiates itself through a geometry-first engineering approach that evaluates motion ratio, leverage curves, load paths, and steering behavior as an integrated system rather than maximizing travel alone. It promotes race-proven materials, in-house manufacturing control, and direct technical support without intermediaries.

name: AZ CAP Co
old_description: Quality Apparel, Promotional Products, and Print to help organizations show up with confidence, on brand, on time, from A to Z.
about:
AZ CAP Co, based in Prescott Valley, Arizona, traces its roots to 1999 when Arizona Cap & Apparel began as a small embroidery operation. The business was later taken over by Eva Janckila and Vance, who expanded its capabilities beyond embroidery into a full-service branding partner for apparel, promotional products, and print.

Today the company provides corporate apparel, headwear, promotional merchandise, signage, and print services from its Prescott Valley facility. Decoration processes include embroidery, screen printing, and direct-to-film (DTF) printing, with full all-over print capability for custom designs. The firm also manages factory-direct custom apparel programs and scalable fulfillment ranging from 25 to 25,000-plus units per order, offering more than 1,000 stocked product options.

Clients span automotive, insurance, event and concert promotion, construction contractors, retail, nonprofits, and financial services. National accounts such as Wells Fargo and PetSmart are referenced alongside marketing, human-resources, and operations teams that rely on the company for uniform programs, executive gifting, safety wear, and branded marketing essentials.

AZ CAP Co emphasizes a consultative approach built on clear communication, in-house expertise, and a vetted supplier network. Its stated differentiators include a 10-day average turnaround for decorated apparel, a sub-1% defect rate, 100% customer-approved designs before production, and 95% of orders completed within 14 business days. The mission is to simplify branded solutions so organizations can show up on brand and on schedule.

name: AZ MediQuip - Peoria
old_description: AZ MediQuip's team understands your situation and provides solutions tailored to your needs.
about:
AZ MediQuip, headquartered in Peoria, Arizona, has been serving the state's home medical equipment needs since 2011. The company operates eight retail showrooms across Arizona, including locations in Phoenix, Scottsdale, Chandler, Mesa, Peoria, Goodyear, Prescott Valley, and Oro Valley.

The company operates as a retailer and rental provider of home medical equipment and supplies. Its showrooms carry a range of products including mobility aids, respiratory equipment, hospital beds, and rehabilitation devices from brands such as ComfyGo, Drive, Inogen, ResMed, and Golden Technologies. AZ MediQuip offers sales, weekly and monthly rentals, in-home installation, equipment repair, and delivery services. The rental fleet mirrors the retail inventory, allowing customers to trial equipment before purchase.

AZ MediQuip serves individuals, families, and healthcare professionals throughout Arizona. Its customer base includes seniors seeking to maintain independence, patients recovering from surgery or injury, and clinical partners requiring equipment for home care. The company also partners with Measurabilies Home Safety LLC to provide free home safety assessments with clinically guided recommendations.

The company emphasizes its large showroom footprint, try-before-you-buy policy, and trained staff who provide personalized guidance. According to AZ MediQuip, its attention to detail and helpful demeanor differentiate it from competitors, aiming to minimize the stress of medical equipment decisions.

about:
Established in 1952 in Garfield Heights, Ohio, Aabaco Plastics began as a packaging solutions provider focused on solving challenging packaging problems. The company has built a reputation as a go-to resource for urgent packaging needs.

Aabaco Plastics operates as a designer, fabricator, converter, and distributor of flexible plastic packaging. Its product line includes flat and gusseted bags, ziplock bags, bubble bags, foam bags, poly mailers, trash bags, pallet covers, construction and agricultural film, tarps, layflat tubing, sheeting, top sheets, and closures. The company offers package design, graphic design, test sampling, and printing services to support custom packaging development.

The company serves customers across industries requiring flexible plastic packaging, though specific sectors are not detailed in its public materials. Its capabilities span from design through fabrication and conversion, enabling both stock and custom orders.

Aabaco Plastics emphasizes superior quality, on-time delivery, and competitive pricing as standard service levels. It highlights the ability to achieve "miracle deliveries" on both stock and non-stock sizes on a weekly basis, backed by a team with deep knowledge of current packaging technology and creative problem-solving.

name: Aaron Smith Industries
old_description: We only use high quality material,and top of the line equipment.
about:
Aaron Smith Industries is a family-owned fabrication shop based in Eagle Creek, Oregon, just outside Portland. The company operates from a facility on SE Highway 224 and emphasizes high-quality materials and equipment.

The shop provides custom fabrication across metal, wood, plastic, and foam. Core processes include certified TIG, MIG, and ARC welding with mobile service; cutting via CNC router, laser, plasma, sawing, and light-gauge metal shearing; sheet metal and pipe forming; sand blasting; and finishes such as powder coating, painting, and wood staining. Design work is handled in-house using V-Carve, Laserworks V8, SketchUp, and Adobe software. The equipment roster features a Smart Shop CNC router, CNC router table, laser cutter/engraver, plasma cutter, saws, and a light-gauge shear.

Aaron Smith Industries serves customers needing signage, custom woodworking, metal fabrication, rapid prototyping, artistic sculpture, jewelry, awards, memorials, and theme-park elements. Past projects cited by the company include 3D model making, sign making, wood carving, CNC routing, engraving, milling, new product designs, custom fireplaces, door panels, statues, jewelry, stone cutting, 3D sculptures, earrings, gifts, personalized awards, memorials, and commemorative plaques.

The company states its differentiation lies in quality, honesty, and speed—"Today it is rare to find quality, honesty and speed. Especially all in the same business," reads one testimonial. Aaron Smith Industries says it uses only high-quality materials and top-of-the-line equipment, maintains precise layout and attention to detail, and aims for efficient turnaround without sacrificing quality, backed by a commitment to 100% customer satisfaction.

name: Absolics Inc.
old_description: When silicon hit a physical wall, we redefined the foundation of computing with glass
about:
Founded in 2018 in Covington, Georgia, Absolics Inc. is a semiconductor packaging company backed by South Korea's SK Group. The venture began under the leadership of CEO Jiho Kang with a mission to redefine computing foundations using glass substrates after silicon hit a physical scaling wall.

The company develops glass substrate platforms for next-generation semiconductor packaging, targeting AI infrastructure and high-performance computing. Its SVM facility in Covington serves as a test and manufacturing ground for high-density packaging. With a team of 16, Absolics operates globally from offices in London and Singapore, supported by $75 million in CHIPS Act manufacturing subsidies and $100 million in R&D funding.

Absolics serves the semiconductor industry, particularly companies advancing AI accelerators, high-performance computing processors, and advanced packaging solutions. Its customers include semiconductor manufacturers and packaging houses seeking alternatives to silicon substrates.

The company was started to overcome the physical scaling limits of silicon by using glass as a substrate material, offering better thermal dissipation and signal integrity for high-density packaging.
built_on: Glass substrate platform that overcomes silicon scaling limits
Global operations across 40+ countries with offices in London and Singapore
Strategic backing from SK Group

name: Absolute Apparel, LLC
old_description: Whether you are looking for a specific item or just browsing for ideas, our site is your one-stop source.
about:
Absolute Apparel, LLC is a promotional product distributor based in Elmore, Alabama, founded in 2022. The company operates as a distributor rather than a manufacturer, sourcing items from a network of more than 3,000 suppliers.

The firm supplies a broad range of ad specialties—including apparel, writing instruments, drinkware, bags, and event giveaways—to businesses and organizations seeking branded merchandise. It does not produce goods itself but provides custom branding services such as logo application, messaging, and Pantone color-matching on select items. The product catalog spans categories tailored for trade shows, political campaigns, real estate promotions, healthcare awareness, charity events, golf tournaments, and hospitality venues.

Customers include corporate marketing teams, event planners, nonprofits, educational institutions, and hospitality operators. The company highlights themed collections for specific occasions, such as golf accessories for tournaments, wine and bar accessories for restaurants, and Made-in-USA products for patriotic celebrations. Its online platform organizes products by event type and industry, allowing buyers to browse by theme or search for specific items.

Absolute Apparel emphasizes its focus on American-made promotional products, positioning that selection as a response to client demand for domestically manufactured giveaways. The stated mission is to help clients build long-lasting relationships through the use of promotional products.
